senses.sense_definition: A manuscript or document that has been erased or scraped clean for reuse of the writing surface.

examples.text: The ancient <w>palimpsest</w> revealed hidden Greek text beneath the later religious writings.
Scholars used special imaging technology to read the original text on the <w>palimpsest</w>.

senses.sense_definition: Something that still shows traces of an earlier, erased form.

examples.text: The city is a <w>palimpsest</w> of different architectural styles from various historical periods.
Her face was a <w>palimpsest</w> of emotions, showing both joy and lingering sadness.

senses.sense_definition: A text or work containing several layers of meaning from different points in time.

examples.text: The novel acts as a <w>palimpsest</w>, where the reader discovers new meanings upon every re-reading.
His poetry is a complex <w>palimpsest</w> of cultural references and personal memories.

senses.sense_definition: To scrape or erase a writing surface to prepare it for reuse.

examples.text: Monks would often <w>palimpsest</w> old scrolls to save expensive parchment for new texts.
It was common practice to <w>palimpsest</w> documents when resources were scarce.
